elements.evidence: Section 12.4 binds Customer through the mutual prohibition on directly soliciting specified Vendor personnel.
Section 12.4 applies to “Neither party” and covers personnel of “the other party.”

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: It is limited to personnel “directly involved in performing or receiving the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: It applies “for twelve months following the end of that individual's involvement in the Services.”

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The restriction expressly excludes “general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel.”

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The restriction expressly does not apply “to unsolicited approaches by an individual.”

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition addresses only direct solicitation, not hiring, and expressly permits hiring or engaging persons responding to general recruitment or approaching unsolicited; Section 12.3 also confirms no no-hire commitment.
